packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor + patch + pin updates after CI passes (minors added 2026-07-21 once required status checks landed fleet-wide). Dockerfile digest bumps stay manual — a broken base-image digest already broke main once (see commit 513b008). docker-compose digests auto-merge via the rule below (docs-example pins, no runtime impact); github-actions digest bumps are NOT auto-merged so a repointed/compromised action SHA still gets a review PR.

Auto-merge digest bumps for docker-compose only (compose.yaml/docker-compose.yml example pins — docs surface, never executed in CI or production). github-actions digests are deliberately NOT auto-merged: SHA-pinning exists to force human review of upstream action changes, and a repointed or compromised tag re-resolves to a new SHA that still passes CI, so those bumps must get a review PR (the old 'broken SHA = action-not-found' rationale only caught deleted SHAs, not malicious ones). Dockerfile FROM digests are also excluded — those drive every build and have caused breakage before. Per-repo opt-outs (e.g. BeatsCheck's chodeus/chodeus-ops carve-out) still take precedence.
Keep pydantic + pydantic-core in lockstep. pydantic strictly pins pydantic-core in its metadata, so bumping one without the other yields an unresolvable PR.
Docker base images — separate PRs so breakage is isolated
Pin all GitHub Actions to SHAs
